[wasm] [asmjs] Fix for invalid AsmJs opcode appearing in stream.

Was not properly guarding the asmjs prefix against bad code.

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix d3e1723bf45a on top of intro 3e7191831b1a via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: When AsmJs opcodes were moved to a new prefix (0xfa) in the refactoring commit 3e7191831b, the new DecodeAsmJsOpcode function was written with V8_ASSUME to assert the opcode prefix rather than validating it. The read_prefixed_opcode function uses LEB128 decoding for the opcode index byte, so a multi-byte LEB128 value (index > 0xFF) produces an opcode with a different bit layout than expected by the ASSUME assertion. The original author assumed V8_ASSUME was a mere optimizer hint, not realizing it also embeds a hard DCHECK in debug builds.
